name: Fair Folk
body:
The term “fair folk” is sometimes used to refer to all fey creatures, but is more specifically used to describe humanoids (usually humans, but sometimes elves or others) whose ancestry has somehow been influenced by magic of the fey.

Sometimes the fair folk are half-fey who are the direct offspring of a union of a human and a fey, for example, but other times the influence is more subtle and hard to identify. Perhaps one’s ancestor made a bargain with the fey, and the child’s identity is the product of that blessing—or curse. In this way, the fair folk are to the fey what aasimars are to celestials or tieflings are to fiends.

Physical

Fair folk are amazingly varied in their appearance. It is believed by some that they are all ethereally beautiful waifs, who look like their parents’ species but slight of build and unearthly in their grace and loveliness.

However, some of the fair folk are less than fair to look at, the influence of the fey coming through in odd and alien ways that leave them misshapen and ugly by ordinary standards. Others have mismatched features that clearly mark them as creatures of the Fey Realms—vibrantly colored skin and hair, scales or feathers, hooves or tails, or ram-like horns.

Social

Like aasimars and tieflings, fair folk have no organized culture of their own. They do their best to blend into their parents’ society, but usually find themselves feeling isolated and alone. Some find comfort among fey, or among others that dwell in the wild places of the world. These communities are usually welcoming of the fair folk; however, even among them most fair folk find that they feel like outsiders. Fair folk are rare enough in most parts of the world that many will never cross paths with another of their kind.

Alignment and Religion

Most fair folk adhere to a Chaotic alignment. As outsiders wherever they go, they are not only used to doing for themselves, but many welcome this autonomy. While many fair folk enjoy adventure and the thrill of meeting new people and gathering new experiences, they also learn to love their freedom, and closely guard their own agendas.

Relatively few fair folk adhere to a major religion, as many find that mainstream faiths do not address their spiritual needs. They do tend to dabble in various philosophies and self-help ideologies, however. Some may also find comfort in what may be called the “understanding of nature” that comes from druidic or shamanic practices.

Base Traits
Ability Score Modifiers You are graceful both physically and socially, but your body is slight. Your ability score adjustments are +2 Dex, +2 Cha, –2 Str [standard].
Size At character creation, choose either Medium or Small size. As a Medium creature, you have no bonuses or penalties due to size. As a Small creature, you have a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a +1 size bonus to your Armor Class, a –1 size penalty to your CMB, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks; you must use smaller weapons than Medium creatures. As a Medium or Small creature, you occupy a space of 5 feet by 5 feet, and your reach is 5 feet.
Type You are a Fey.
Speed Normal. Your base speed is 30 feet.
Languages You begin play speaking Common and Sylvan. If you have a high Intelligence score, you can choose from any of the following languages: Dwarven, Elven, Giant, Gnome, Goblin, or Halfling.
Alternate Traits
Fleet-Footed You are gifted with the light step of the fey. You receive Run as a bonus feat and a +2 species bonus on initiative checks.
Low-Light Vision You can see twice as far as a human in starlight, moonlight, torchlight, and similar conditions of poor illumination. You retain the ability to distinguish color and detail under these conditions.
Resistant Your unique heritage provides you with a +2 species bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects and poison.
Spell-Like Abilities You can use dancing lights, disguise self, and faerie fire once per day each as spell-like abilities. Your character level is your caster level, and Charisma is your casting ability.
Skilled You gain a +2 species bonus to Bluff and Stealth checks.
